newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's DFC announces interest payout on Tier 2 debt.
newsitem.headline: NZ's DFC announces interest payout on Tier 2 debt.

text.p: DFC's statutory managers said on Friday approximately NZ$28.5 million would be paid out as interest on DFC's Tier 2 new debt.
Payment will occur on October 15, when 66 percent of current interest (interest accrued since April 15) will be paid out.
DFC's Tier 2 new debt was issued as part of the restructuring of DFC's debt in December 1990. It matures in October 1997, when the full amount of principal is due to be paid out to debt holders.
Statutory Manager John Waller said there were now only a small number of claims outstanding against DFC and they were being vigorously defended.
After this interest payment, the Statutory Managers will be holding approximately $22.5 million in cash on deposit.
The extent to which these funds can be subsequently distributed as interest to Tier 2 debtholders would be dependent on resolution of claims outstanding and other residual issues, he said.
